name: Aaron
role: Brother of Moses; the lesser priesthood bears his name
dateNote: Section 84, dated 22–23 September 1832, gives the fullest account of him in the D&C.
importance: Section 84 says the Lord confirmed a priesthood on Aaron and his seed. It says this lesser priesthood continued with “the house of Aaron” until John the Baptist. Teachers and deacons are called appendages of that priesthood. The revelation speaks of faithful members becoming “the sons of Moses and of Aaron”.
connections: The D&C presents him as Moses’s brother and companion. Section 28 compares Oliver Cowdery’s role to Aaron’s beside Moses.
reviewNote: Described only as the D&C presents him. Checked 84:18, 26–27, 30–32, 34 on the official page; 28:3 in local text. Caution for linking: 124:132 names a different man, “Aaron Johnson”; a linker should not tag that occurrence.
